parsed.post: Discarding my recent run (0.994793) as it was slightly worse than my previous best (0.988277). It seems the batch size reduction might have introduced too much noise or the learning rate is slightly off for this smaller batch. I will revert to the previous best and try increasing the depth to 8 to see if capacity gains offset the training time.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 to test if increased model capacity improves val_bpb within the 5-minute budget, using the previous best hyperparameters.
